SELECT 
    m.plant_id,
    p.plant_name,
    COUNT(*) AS unplanned_events,
    ROUND(SUM(me.downtime_hours), 1) AS total_unplanned_downtime_hours
FROM manufacturing_operations.maintenance_events AS me
JOIN manufacturing_operations.machines AS m USING (machine_id)
JOIN manufacturing_operations.plants AS p USING (plant_id)
WHERE me.event_type = 'unplanned'
  AND me.started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
  AND me.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY m.plant_id, p.plant_name
ORDER BY total_unplanned_downtime_hours DESC

SELECT machine_id, plant_id, machine_type
FROM manufacturing_operations.machines
WHERE machine_id IN ('DAY-LTH-05', 'DAY-PRS-04', 'BRN-LTH-04', 'BRN-LTH-03', 'DAY-MIL-02')
ORDER BY 
  CASE machine_id 
    WHEN 'DAY-LTH-05' THEN 1
    WHEN 'DAY-PRS-04' THEN 2
    WHEN 'BRN-LTH-04' THEN 3
    WHEN 'BRN-LTH-03' THEN 4
    WHEN 'DAY-MIL-02' THEN 5
  END

WITH last_pm2 AS (
  SELECT
    m.machine_id,
    m.machine_type,
    m.plant_id,
    COALESCE(MAX(me.started_at)::date, m.commissioned_date) as last_pm2_date
  FROM manufacturing_operations.machines m
  LEFT JOIN manufacturing_operations.maintenance_events me
    ON m.machine_id = me.machine_id
    AND me.event_type = 'planned'
    AND me.task_code = 'PM-2'
  GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.machine_type, m.plant_id, m.commissioned_date
),
intervals AS (
  SELECT
    machine_id,
    machine_type,
    plant_id,
    last_pm2_date,
    CASE machine_type
      WHEN 'CNC Mill' THEN 90
      WHEN 'CNC Lathe' THEN 120
      WHEN 'Hydraulic Press' THEN 60
      WHEN 'Robot Cell' THEN 180
      WHEN 'Surface Grinder' THEN 90
      ELSE NULL
    END as pm2_interval_days,
    DATE '2026-09-30' as reference_date
  FROM last_pm2
),
overdue AS (
  SELECT
    machine_id,
    machine_type,
    plant_id,
    last_pm2_date,
    pm2_interval_days,
    reference_date,
    (reference_date - last_pm2_date) as days_since_pm2,
    (reference_date - last_pm2_date) - pm2_interval_days as days_overdue
  FROM intervals
)
SELECT
  machine_id,
  machine_type,
  plant_id,
  last_pm2_date,
  pm2_interval_days,
  days_since_pm2,
  days_overdue
FROM overdue
WHERE days_overdue > 0
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC;

WITH last_pm2 AS (
  SELECT
    m.machine_id,
    m.machine_type,
    m.plant_id,
    MAX(me.started_at)::date as last_pm2_date
  FROM manufacturing_operations.machines m
  LEFT JOIN manufacturing_operations.maintenance_events me
    ON m.machine_id = me.machine_id
    AND me.event_type = 'planned'
    AND me.task_code = 'PM-2'
  GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.machine_type, m.plant_id
)
SELECT * FROM last_pm2 ORDER BY machine_id;

WITH unplanned_events AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS unplanned_event_count,
    SUM(downtime_hours) AS total_unplanned_downtime_hours,
    SUM(parts_and_labor_cost_usd) AS total_unplanned_cost_usd
  FROM manufacturing_operations.maintenance_events
  WHERE machine_id = 'MTY-LTH-04'
    AND event_type = 'unplanned'
    AND started_at >= '2026-07-01'
),
defect_costs AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(cost_usd) AS total_defect_cost_usd
  FROM manufacturing_operations.quality_defects
  WHERE machine_id = 'MTY-LTH-04'
    AND detected_at >= '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  ue.unplanned_event_count,
  ue.total_unplanned_downtime_hours,
  ue.total_unplanned_cost_usd,
  dc.total_defect_cost_usd
FROM unplanned_events ue
CROSS JOIN defect_costs dc;
